source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cat > /root/provenance_weight_training/output/figures/plot_tau_sensitivity_v2.py << 'PYEOF'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import numpy as np

tau =       [0.50,   0.60,   0.70,   0.80,   0.90,   0.95]
ppl =       [17.688, 17.6805,17.6793,17.6527,17.712, 17.723]
bstar_mean= [0.3923, 0.5899, 0.8943, 1.399,  2.36,   3.0775]

uniform_ppl = 17.6939

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))

# Safe range shading
ax1.axvspan(0.50, 0.80, alpha=0.08, color='#2196F3', zorder=0)
ax1.text(0.65, 17.73, 'Safe range', fontsize=11, color='#1565C0',
         ha='center', va='bottom', fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.8)

# Uniform baseline
ax1.axhline(y=uniform_ppl, color='#888888', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, zorder=1)
ax1.text(0.95, uniform_ppl + 0.002, 'Uniform', fontsize=10, color='#888888',
         ha='right', va='bottom')

# Left axis: PPL
color_ppl = '#1565C0'
ax1.plot(tau, ppl, 'o-', color=color_ppl, linewidth=2, markersize=7,
         markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=2, markeredgecolor=color_ppl,
         label='Held-out PPL', zorder=3)
# Highlight optimal τ=0.8
opt_idx = 3
ax1.plot(tau[opt_idx], ppl[opt_idx], '*', color=color_ppl, markersize=18,
         markeredgecolor='#0D47A1', markeredgewidth=1, zorder=4)
ax1.annotate(f'τ*=0.8\nPPL={ppl[opt_idx]:.4f}',
             xy=(tau[opt_idx], ppl[opt_idx]),
             xytext=(tau[opt_idx] - 0.08, ppl[opt_idx] - 0.025),
             fontsize=9, color=color_ppl, fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color_ppl, lw=1.2),
             ha='center', va='top')

ax1.set_xlabel(r'$\tau$ (Effective Weight Threshold)', fontsize=13)
ax1.set_ylabel('Held-out Perplexity (PPL)', fontsize=13, color=color_ppl)
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_ppl, labelsize=11)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=11)
ax1.set_xlim(0.45, 1.0)
ax1.set_xticks(tau)

# Right axis: b* mean
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
color_b = '#C62828'
ax2.plot(tau, bstar_mean, 's--', color=color_b, linewidth=2, markersize=7,
         markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=2, markeredgecolor=color_b,
         label=r'Mean $b^*$', zorder=3)
ax2.plot(tau[opt_idx], bstar_mean[opt_idx], '*', color=color_b, markersize=18,
         markeredgecolor='#7f1d1d', markeredgewidth=1, zorder=4)

ax2.set_ylabel(r'Mean $b^*$', fontsize=13, color=color_b)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_b, labelsize=11)

# Combined legend
lines1, labels1 = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax1.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper left',
           fontsize=11, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')

ax1.set_title(r'Effect of $\tau$ on Perplexity and Weight Magnitude', fontsize=14, pad=12)

fig.tight_layout()

out_dir = '/root/provenance_weight_training/output/figures'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/tau_sensitivity.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/tau_sensitivity.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
plt.close()
print('Done.')
PYEOF
